equatorial.note: Usually an adjective, as in "equatorial mount".

capping.note: Most often "capping" means putting a limit on something: "capping prices".

rudiment.note: Most often "rudiments" means the basics: "the rudiments of grammar".

quadruplet.note: Most often "quadruplets" are four babies born at the same time.

reformat.note: Mostly a verb: "reformat the hard drive".

amphitryon.note: Very rare and literary; "host" is the everyday word.
